_comment: Single source for every manifest. Edit this, then run scripts/gen_manifests.py. The generated files are checked in so installs need no build step, and scripts/tests/test_manifests.py fails if they drift from this file.

shared.name: trellis
shared.description: Local kanban and knowledge base for AI agents: board state at session start, cards with leases, and a linked markdown knowledge base.

marketplace.description: Local kanban and knowledge base for AI agents. SessionStart hook injects board state and a command cheatsheet. The skill covers claiming work, logging progress, and when to write knowledge.
marketplace.pluginDescription: Work with trellis board state, cards, and knowledge. SessionStart hook for adoption.

interface.shortDescription: Local kanban and knowledge for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Trellis gives AI coding agents a local kanban board and linked markdown knowledge base. Use it to claim work safely, record progress, preserve discoveries, and recover context across sessions.
defaultPrompt: Show my Trellis work and blockers.
Claim the next available Trellis card.
Save this session's verified findings in Trellis.
